title: 客户复购率与统计粒度
learningObjective: 能够从订单粒度转换到客户粒度，正确计算期间复购人数与复购率。
concept: 复购率是期间有至少两笔有效购买的客户人数÷有至少一笔有效购买的客户人数×100%。不是复购订单占比，也不是所有注册客户中复购客户的占比。一个订单可能有多条商品明细，必须按订单编号计数；同一客户的有效订单次数再用于分类。
syntax:
WITH purchases AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) purchase_count
  FROM customers c JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
    AND o.net_cents>0
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS purchasing_customers,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_count>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS repeat_customers,
  ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_count>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0),2) AS repeat_pct
FROM purchases

executionSteps: 按客户计算不同订单数
useCase: 2025全年、线上、已完成且扣退款后净额大于0的订单，关联客户主档。全额退款、取消、待付款、期外或线下订单不计。原项目净订单视图已经处理已完成状态及退款；再次扣退款会重复冲减。无有效购买客户时返回人数0、比率NULL。
comparison: 分母不是订单数、注册人数或商品行数；本期复购与历史首购分群不同。

commonError.example: 直接在订单明细层用 COUNT(*) 算购买次数，或以所有客户为分母。
commonError.correction: 先计算不同有效订单数，再在客户粒度统计人数。

notes: 示例采用可逐笔核对的小型数据，练习采用正式业务数据库。金额单位为马币分。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

setupSql:
CREATE VIEW v_sales_lines AS SELECT i.order_item_id,o.order_id,o.store_id,o.customer_id,o.session_id,o.channel,o.order_date,i.product_id,i.promotion_id,i.quantity-COALESCE(r.qty,0) AS net_qty,i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents-i.discount_cents-COALESCE(r.refund,0) AS net_cents,(i.quantity-COALESCE(r.qty,0))*i.unit_cost_cents AS cost_cents,i.discount_cents,COALESCE(r.refund,0) AS refund_cents FROM orders o JOIN order_items i ON o.order_id=i.order_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT order_item_id,SUM(quantity) qty,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM returns WHERE return_date<='2025-12-31' GROUP BY order_item_id) r ON r.order_item_id=i.order_item_id WHERE o.status='completed';
CREATE VIEW v_order_net AS SELECT order_id,store_id,customer_id,session_id,channel,order_date,SUM(net_cents) net_cents,SUM(cost_cents) cost_cents FROM v_sales_lines GROUP BY order_id,store_id,customer_id,session_id,channel,order_date;

teaching.problem: 2025全年、线上、已完成且扣退款后净额大于0的订单，关联客户主档。全额退款、取消、待付款、期外或线下订单不计。原项目净订单视图已经处理已完成状态及退款；再次扣退款会重复冲减。无有效购买客户时返回人数0、比率NULL。
teaching.codeExplanation: 先在订单层过滤范围和净额，再连接客户主档排除无有效客户编号的记录。COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) 保证一笔订单只数一次；GROUP BY c.customer_id 将订单粒度转换为客户粒度。外层 COUNT(*) 是购买客户人数，因为内层每人仅一行；SUM(CASE WHEN purchase_count>=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) 给每位复购客户计1。乘100.0、NULLIF 防止整数截断和除零，COALESCE 让空输入的复购人数为0。独立示例直接模拟已处理好的订单视图，不代表原始订单表的全部记录。
teaching.resultExplanation: 客户1两笔有效订单，客户2一笔有效订单且另一笔全退；客户3的线上订单在2026年、线下订单不纳入；客户4无有效订单。分母2人、分子1人，复购率50%。原项目小型案例也给出2、1、50。这个比率仅反映本期至少购买两次的情况，不能解释历史老客户占比，也不能证明复购增长。

checkpoints.sql:
WITH purchases AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) purchase_count
  FROM customers c JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id
  WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'

mergeExamples.label: 小型示例：有效订单明细
mergeExamples.sql:
WITH customers(customer_id) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4),
v_order_net(order_id,customer_id,channel,order_date,net_cents) AS (SELECT 5,1,'online','2025-01-02',100 UNION ALL SELECT 6,1,'online','2025-03-02',60 UNION ALL SELECT 7,2,'online','2025-03-03',40 UNION ALL SELECT 8,2,'online','2025-04-03',0 UNION ALL SELECT 11,3,'online','2026-01-01',200 UNION ALL SELECT 12,3,'store','2025-05-01',100),
purchases AS (SELECT c.customer_id,COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) purchase_count FROM customers c JOIN v_order_net o ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id WHERE o.channel='online' AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND o.net_cents>0 GROUP BY c.customer_id)
SELECT order_id,customer_id,net_cents FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND net_cents>0 ORDER BY net_cents;
